title: ഒപ്പോസം മരണ അഭിനയം Playing Possum: Nature’s Survival Trick | Virginia Opossum & Death Mimics
description:
Discover the incredible survival strategies of the Virginia opossum in this fascinating video! Learn how these unique marsupials use their famous "playing possum" trick—mimicking death to fool predators. From their nomadic lifestyle to their surprising immune system, we dive into the opossum’s clever adaptations that help it thrive in the wild. Perfect for wildlife enthusiasts and curious minds! 🐾✨ #Opossum #Wildlife #nature #malayalam #nature #facts #science #education #ഒപ്പോസം #മരണം #മിമിക്രി
